_note: Kinds of routine any build can run. Each kind is composed by code in src/puffpai/routines.py from what the build already has (its live info cards, its own library, the date). No kind is about one topic. Owner-visible text lives in 'label', 'what_it_does' and 'offer_detail' and must stay plain words.

kinds.label: Daily update
kinds.what_it_does: Once a day, a short note with the date, the latest from your live info cards, and one thing from your bot's own library.
kinds.offer_detail: A short note once a day, made on this computer: the date, the latest from your live info cards, and one thing from your bot's library. Making it sends nothing new off your computer.

kinds.label: Watch
kinds.what_it_does: Tells you when a number on one of your live info cards goes above or below a line you pick, or when a list on a card gets something new.

kinds.label: Reminder
kinds.what_it_does: Says a message you wrote, at the time you pick.

kinds.label: Daily task
kinds.what_it_does: Once a day, your bot does a job you asked for (a lesson, a plan, a summary) with its usual tools, and keeps a short note so each day builds on the last. A command still waits for your yes.
